title: CIT168 Subcortical Atlas for the ggsegverse Ecosystem
text: CIT168 probabilistic subcortical atlas ggseg ecosystem. Pauli colleagues built CIT168 high-resolution 7 Tesla Human Connectome Project data. gives 14 structures per hemisphere: striatum pallidum alongside small midbrain diencephalic nuclei coarser atlases lump together “ventral DC” — substantia nigra (pars compacta pars reticulata), red nucleus, subthalamic nucleus, habenula mammillary body. Labels keep abbreviations published lookup table uses, still match source: Pu_Left, SNc_PBP_VTA_Right. region column stripped hemisphere lower-cased (pu, snc pbp vta), name column carries spelled-structure name printing.

title: CIT168 Reinforcement-Learning Subcortical Atlas — cit168
text: Probabilistic subcortical atlas built high-resolution 7 Tesla Human Connectome Project data, 14 structures per hemisphere. covers striatum pallidum alongside small midbrain diencephalic nuclei coarser atlases lump together "ventral DC": substantia nigra (pars compacta pars reticulata), red nucleus, subthalamic nucleus, habenula mammillary body. Drawn four views, two coronal two axial, surrounding brain grey anatomical context. Contains 2D polygon geometry ggseg::geom_brain() 3D mesh data ggseg3d::ggseg3d().
